## Architecture and data flow

| Layer | Component | Responsibility / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| User | {{USER_AND_VALIDATED_CHANNEL}} | Authenticated entry point |
| Agent | Global instructions and model | Scope, evidence, language and orchestration |
| Skills | {{CAPABILITY_IDS}} | Reusable task-specific procedures, not deterministic triggers |
| Knowledge | {{SOURCES_OR_NONE}} | Permission-trimmed evidence; declared freshness |
| Tools | {{ACTUAL_TOOLS_OR_PROPOSED_CONTRACTS_OR_NONE}} | Callable operations, not Markdown implementations |
| Backend | {{IDENTITY_AND_POLICY_ENFORCEMENT}} | Record, field, action and approval enforcement |

Describe the full path from request to evidence, decisions, any action, verification
and response. Distinguish indexed knowledge, user-provided text, and live records.

## Identity, permissions and data handling

{{AUTHENTICATED_CALLER_MAPPING_SOURCE_ACLS_APPROVAL_AND_RETENTION}}

Distinguish ingestion identity from end-user retrieval and tool execution identity.
Do not use prompt instructions as the access-control boundary. Coordinate backend
policy and tool removal when disabling a capability, including alternate paths and
stale sessions. Never cache permission decisions as user-profile context.
